description: Source code for the InputMetadata class and related functions in PyTorch's autograd module, handling tensor shape metadata, nested tensors, and shape compatibility checks.

classes.name: InputMetadata
classes.description: Class representing metadata about tensor inputs, including shape, nestedness, and dtype information, with methods for shape compatibility and reduction.

methods.name: compute_variant_shape
methods.description: Computes the shape variant of a tensor, handling nested tensors and their sizes.

methods.name: is_python_dispatch
methods.description: Checks if a tensor uses Python dispatch.

methods.name: is_cpp_nested_tensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is a C++ nested tensor.

methods.name: InputMetadata::InputMetadata
methods.description: Constructor initializing InputMetadata with tensor options and shape info.

methods.name: InputMetadata::InputMetadata
methods.description: Constructor initializing InputMetadata from a tensor.

methods.name: zeros_like
methods.description: Returns a tensor of zeros with the same shape and options.

methods.name: maybe_reduce
methods.description: Reduces gradient tensor to match input shape if necessary.

methods.name: is_same_shape
methods.description: Checks if a gradient tensor has the same shape as the input.

methods.name: is_expandable_to_shape
methods.description: Checks if a tensor can be expanded to match the input shape.

methods.name: reduce_grad
methods.description: Reduces a gradient tensor to the input shape.

methods.name: incompatible_shape_error_message
methods.description: Generates an error message for shape incompatibility.

methods.name: is_cpp_nested_tensor
methods.description: Determines if the shape represents a C++ nested tensor.

methods.name: shape_as_dim_vector
methods.description: Returns the shape as a SymIntArrayRef.

methods.name: mutable_shape_as_dim_vector
methods.description: Provides mutable access to shape as SymIntSmallVec.

methods.name: is_nestedness_same
methods.description: Checks if the nestedness of a tensor matches the metadata.

methods.name: shape_as_tensor
methods.description: Returns the shape as a tensor.

methods.name: maybe_expandable_to
methods.description: Checks if the input can be expanded to match the shape.
